title: page:header / page:tabs / record:details: five keys spec 17.0.0 GA declares and the renderers already honour are never published as inputs
body:
Filed unassigned from the objectui#4648 implementation run (dev seat, 2026-08-15). Blocked-by: #4636 (the `@objectstack/spec` GA pin bump, PR #4639) — the declarations cannot land before the pin moves, see "Why this cannot land today".

## The gap

`@objectstack/spec@17.0.0` GA adds five top-level keys to three blocks this repo already covers in the repo-wide registry-inputs parity gate. All five are honoured by the renderers **today**, and none of them is in the block's published `inputs`:

| block | key | renderer read site (objectui `main` @ `6d4f5bd59`) |
|---|---|---|
| `page:header` | `maxVisible` | `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx:1360` — `readMax(schema?.maxVisible ?? schema?.properties?.maxVisible) ?? 3`, the desktop inline/overflow action split |
| `page:header` | `mobileMaxVisible` | same site, `:1359` — the mobile budget, default 1 |
| `page:tabs` | `alwaysShowStrip` | `containers.tsx:637` — `schema?.properties?.alwaysShowStrip === true` keeps the tab strip visible with a single tab |
| `record:details` | `inlineEdit` | `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx:234` — `(schema.inlineEdit ?? true) && objectInlineEditable` |
| `record:details` | `showHeader` | `record-details.tsx:257` — `schema.showHeader ?? false` |

This is the A-class shape the parity gate's own doc bar names: a key the spec declares, the renderer honours, and `inputs` omits does not exist as far as an author can tell — `gen-manifest.ts` leaves it out of `sdui.manifest.json` and `sdui-intrinsics.d.ts`, `sdui-parser`'s `validate.ts` reports `unknown-prop` on an author who writes it, and the renderer honours it anyway. Same defect as `record:details.hideFields` in #3808 and `readonly` in #3407.

## Why this cannot land today

The pinned spec on `main` is `^17.0.0-rc.6`, which does not declare any of the five. Publishing them now fails the parity gate's FORWARD direction on the current pin ("a block may not DECLARE a top-level input its spec props schema does not accept"), and a forward-direction exemption to cover that would itself go stale — and red — the moment the pin moves to GA. The two clauses collide and "must stay green on current main" wins, exactly as PR #4660 recorded for `SECRET_MASK`.

So the place is held instead: objectui#4648's PR adds five GA-armed entries to `UNPUBLISHED_EXEMPTIONS` in `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`, each naming its read site and this issue. The entries are dormant on the rc.6 pin and fully judged once the installed spec carries the GA element set.

## Done when

- the five keys are declared as `inputs` on their blocks, with descriptions (the `record:details.hideFields` entry is the model);
- the five entries are deleted from `UNPUBLISHED_EXEMPTIONS` — the gate's `carries no stale unpublished-key exemption` test demands exactly that once they are published;
- repo-root parity suite green on the GA pin.

Natural home is the pin-bump PR #4639 itself or a follow-up on top of it; either way it needs the GA pin installed.
